english_draft: ASML reported Q3 2026 total net sales of EUR 11.662 billion, gross margin 57.5%, and net income of EUR 4.960 billion. Installed Base Management sales were EUR 3.289 billion. Q4 2026 sales guidance is EUR 14.2–15.2 billion. No same-period preview exists; historical reconstruction is not used as a forecast.
reader_questions: Q4 指引 142 亿—152 亿欧元是否隐含旺季回升？
57.5% 毛利率是否含一次性项目？
设备管理销售额 32.89 亿欧元的利润贡献多少？
fact_checks: Q3 2026 总净销售额为 EUR 11.662 billion，非全年或 Q4 单季值。
毛利率 57.5%、净利润 EUR 4.960 billion 来自同一 IR 新闻稿。
Q4 销售额指引 EUR 14.2–15.2 billion；Installed Base Management 销售额 EUR 3.289 billion。
